```{r}
library(MCMCpack)   # for Dirichlet()
library(MASS)       # for mvrnorm if needed

simulate_topics_dirichlet <- function(
  N = 1000,         # number of cells
  G = 500,          # number of genes
  K = 5,            # number of topics
  frac_diff = 0.4,  # fraction of topics with nonzero beta
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1️⃣ Condition assignment
  # -------------------------
  X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)   # 0 = control, 1 = treatment
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2️⃣ Topic-level effects
  # -------------------------
  mu_k   <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)
  diff_k <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), K, replace = TRUE,
                   prob = c(frac_diff, 1 - frac_diff))
  beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean = beta_strength, sd = 2), 0)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 3️⃣ Latent logits η_{nk}
  # -------------------------
  eta <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = K)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    eta[, k] <- rnorm(N, mean = mu_k[k] + X * beta_k[k], sd = 1)
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 4️⃣ Topic proportions (softmax)
  # -------------------------
  softmax <- function(v) exp(v) / sum(exp(v))
  ## Topic proportions per sample (cells × topics)
  Z <- t(apply(eta, 1, softmax))
  stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(Z) - 1) < 1e-8))
  
  # -------------------------
  # 5️⃣ Topic–gene weights with Dirichlet normalization
  # -------------------------
  T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K * G, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 1), K, G)
  ## Topic–gene weights (topics × genes)
  W <- matrix(NA, nrow = K, ncol = G)
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    W[k, ] <- rdirichlet(1, alpha = T_mat[k, ])
  }
  rownames(W) <- paste0("Topic", seq_len(K))
  
  # -------------------------
  # 6️⃣ Library size per cell
  # -------------------------
  l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 7️⃣ Gene-specific dispersion
  # -------------------------
  alpha_g <- rexp(G, rate = 0.2)   # mean = 5
  
  # -------------------------
  # 8️⃣ Latent mean expression
  # -------------------------
  mean_ng <- Z %*% W   # expected proportion per gene
  mean_ng <- mean_ng * l_n  # scale by library size
  
  # -------------------------
  # 9️⃣ Gamma–Poisson hierarchy
  # -------------------------
  X_ng <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = G)
  for (g in seq_len(G)) {
    shape <- alpha_g[g]
    rate  <- alpha_g[g] / mean_ng[, g]
    X_ng[, g] <- rgamma(N, shape = shape, rate = rate)
  }
  Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N * G, lambda = as.vector(X_ng)), N, G)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 🔟 Return simulation outputs
  # -------------------------
  list(
    Y = Y_ng,                  # observed counts
    Z = Z,                     # topic proportions
    W = W,                     # topic–gene weights
    beta_true = beta_k,        # true condition effects
    diff_topics = diff_k,      # logical vector
    diff_topic_ids = which(diff_k),
    X = X,                     # condition
    mu = mu_k,
    alpha_g = alpha_g,
    library_size = l_n
  )
}
```

## pairwise log +limma
```{r}
run_one_sim_pairwise <- function(
  N = 1000, G = 300, K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 1
) {
  # ---- 1️⃣ Simulate data ----
  sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
    N = N,
    G = G,
    K = K,
    frac_diff = frac_diff,
    beta_strength = beta_strength,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  Z <- sim$Z
  X_cond <- sim$X
  true_topics <- sim$diff_topics  # which topics truly differ
  
  # ---- 2️⃣ Pairwise log-contrast transform ----
  eps <- 1e-8   # avoid log(0)
  combs <- combn(K, 2)  # all topic pairs (k, l)
  n_pairs <- ncol(combs)
  
  Z_pair <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Z), ncol = n_pairs)
  colnames(Z_pair) <- paste0("log(T", combs[1, ], "/T", combs[2, ], ")")
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_pairs)) {
    k <- combs[1, i]
    l <- combs[2, i]
    Z_pair[, i] <- log((Z[, k] + eps) / (Z[, l] + eps))
  }
  
  # ---- 3️⃣ Design matrix ----
  design <- model.matrix(~ X_cond)
  
  # ---- 4️⃣ Fit limma model ----
  fit <- lmFit(t(Z_pair), design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  # ---- 5️⃣ Extract results ----
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf)
  
  # ---- 6️⃣ Discoveries ----
  disc <- res$adj.P.Val < 0.05
  
  # ---- 7️⃣ Return ----
  list(
    disc = disc,                       # which pairs significant
    true_topics = true_topics,         # true differential topics
    pvals = res$P.Value,               # raw p-values
    adj_pvals = res$adj.P.Val,         # FDR-adjusted p-values
    res = res,
    pairs = combs                      # record which (k,l) each test corresponds to
  )
}

```

```{r}
pairwise_summary <- function(res, combs, K) {
  topic_hits <- numeric(K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    involved <- which(combs[1, ] == k | combs[2, ] == k)
    topic_hits[k] <- sum(res$adj.P.Val[involved] < 0.05)
  }
  topic_hits
}

```

```{r}
run_one_sim_pairwise <- function(
  N = 1000, G = 300, K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 1
) {
  sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
    N = N, G = G, K = K,
    frac_diff = frac_diff,
    beta_strength = beta_strength,
    seed = seed
  )

  Z <- sim$Z
  X_cond <- sim$X
  beta_true <- sim$beta_true
  true_topics <- sim$diff_topics
  
  # --- Pairwise log-ratio features ---
  combs <- combn(K, 2)
  npairs <- ncol(combs)
  eps <- 1e-8
  lograt_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = npairs)
  colnames(lograt_mat) <- apply(combs, 2, function(x)
    paste0("T", x[1], "_vs_T", x[2])
  )

  for (j in seq_len(npairs)) {
    k <- combs[1, j]; l <- combs[2, j]
    lograt_mat[, j] <- log((Z[, k] + eps) / (Z[, l] + eps))
  }

  # --- limma model ---
  design <- model.matrix(~ X_cond)
  fit <- lmFit(t(lograt_mat), design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number = Inf,sort.by = "none")
  disc <- res$adj.P.Val < 0.05


  # --- Define pairwise truth ---
  pair_true <- apply(combs, 2, function(x)
    beta_true[x[1]] != beta_true[x[2]]
  )
  #   # === Sanity check: ensure ordering matches ===
  # cat("\n=== Checking order alignment ===\n")
  # 
  # # 1️⃣ Print first few pairs from combs
  # cat("Pairs from combs:\n")
  # print(head(t(combs)))   # transpose to make each row one pair
  # 
  # # 2️⃣ Check lograt_mat column names (should match combs)
  # cat("\nColumn names of lograt_mat:\n")
  # print(head(colnames(lograt_mat)))
  # 
  # # 3️⃣ Check that limma results come back in same order
  # cat("\nRow names of limma result table (topTable):\n")
  # print(head(rownames(res)))
  # 
  # # 4️⃣ Optional: show pairwise TRUE/FALSE alignment
  # cat("\nPairwise truth vector (first few):\n")
  # print(head(pair_true))
  # 
  # # 5️⃣ Verify equality of names (important check)
  # cat("\nsame?:\n")
  # print(all(rownames(res) == colnames(lograt_mat)))


  list(
    disc = disc,              # discovered pairs
    pair_true = pair_true,    # true signal pairs
    res = res,
    combs = combs,
    true_topics = true_topics,   
    beta_true = beta_true     # keep for later inspection
  )
  
}

```

```{r}
compute_metrics_pairs <- function(disc, pair_true) {
  # Number of pairs
  n_total <- length(disc)
  stopifnot(length(pair_true) == n_total)
  
  # --- Power (sensitivity)
  if (any(pair_true)) {
    power <- mean(disc[pair_true])   # among true pairs, proportion discovered
  } else {
    power <- NA
  }
  
  # --- Empirical FDR
  n_disc <- sum(disc)
  if (n_disc == 0) {
    emp_fdr <- 0
  } else {
    false_pos <- disc & !pair_true
    emp_fdr <- sum(false_pos) / n_disc
  }
  
  list(power = power, emp_fdr = emp_fdr)
}

```

```{r}
set.seed(999)

R <- 100
power_vec <- numeric(R)
fdr_vec   <- numeric(R)

for (r in 1:R) {
  out <- run_one_sim_pairwise(
    N = 2000,
    G = 300,
    K = 6,
    frac_diff = 0.4,
    beta_strength = 2,
    seed = r
  )

  # Use the pairwise version of compute_metrics
  m <- compute_metrics_pairs(out$disc, out$pair_true)
  power_vec[r] <- m$power
  fdr_vec[r]   <- m$emp_fdr
}

cat("=== Pairwise log contrast + limma : SIGNAL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean power across 100 sims     =", round(mean(power_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims =", round(mean(fdr_vec, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Prop runs with ANY detection    =", round(mean(power_vec > 0, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
```

## satbility
```{r}
stability_for_dataset_pairwise <- function(sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05) {
  # sim = output of simulate_topics_dirichlet()
  # B   = number of bootstrap resamples
  
  Z <- sim$Z          # N x K topic proportions
  X <- sim$X          # condition labels
  K <- ncol(Z)
  eps <- 1e-8
  
  # Define all pairwise combinations (K choose 2)
  combs <- combn(K, 2)
  npairs <- ncol(combs)
  
  # Matrix to store discovery calls (bootstraps × pairs)
  disc_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = B, ncol = npairs)
  colnames(disc_mat) <- apply(combs, 2, function(x)
    paste0("T", x[1], "_vs_T", x[2])
  )
  
  # ---------- Bootstrap loop ----------
  for (b in 1:B) {
    # 1️⃣ Resample cells (rows of Z)
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Z)), replace = TRUE)
    Z_b <- Z[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_b <- X[idx]
    
    # 2️⃣ Compute pairwise log-ratios for each bootstrap
    lograt_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Z_b), ncol = npairs)
    for (j in seq_len(npairs)) {
      k <- combs[1, j]
      l <- combs[2, j]
      lograt_mat[, j] <- log((Z_b[, k] + eps) / (Z_b[, l] + eps))
    }
    colnames(lograt_mat) <- apply(combs, 2, function(x)
      paste0("T", x[1], "_vs_T", x[2])
    )
    
    # 3️⃣ Design matrix for limma
    design_b <- model.matrix(~ X_b)
    
    # 4️⃣ limma model fit
    fit_b <- lmFit(t(lograt_mat), design_b)
    fit_b <- eBayes(fit_b)
    res_b <- topTable(fit_b, coef = 2, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")
    
    # 5️⃣ Call discoveries at given FDR
    disc_mat[b, ] <- (res_b$adj.P.Val < fdr_thresh)
  }
  
  # ---------- Stability metrics ----------
  
  # 1️⃣ Per-pair stability (frequency of being significant)
  pair_freq <- colMeans(disc_mat)
  
  # 2️⃣ Set-level stability via pairwise Jaccard overlap
  jaccard <- function(a, b) {
    inter <- sum(a & b)
    union <- sum(a | b)
    if (union == 0) return(NA_real_)
    inter / union
  }
  
  pair_ids <- combn(B, 2)
  jacc_vals <- apply(pair_ids, 2, function(ix)
    jaccard(disc_mat[ix[1], ], disc_mat[ix[2], ])
  )
  
  mean_jacc <- mean(jacc_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # ---------- Return ----------
  list(
    pair_freq = pair_freq,    # stability of each pairwise log contrast [0–1]
    mean_jacc = mean_jacc,    # overall stability of discovery sets
    disc_mat = disc_mat       # raw discovery matrix (bootstraps × pairs)
  )
}

```

```{r}
set.seed(999)

R <- 100
power_vec    <- numeric(R)
fdr_vec      <- numeric(R)
stab_jaccvec <- numeric(R)    # one stability score per simulation
stab_avgfreq <- numeric(R)    # avg per-topic freq of discoveries

for (r in 1:R) {
  # ---- simulate ONE dataset with signal
  sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
    N = 2000,
    G = 300,
    K = 6,
    frac_diff = 0.4,      # some topics truly change with condition
    beta_strength = 2,
    seed = r
  )
  
  # ---- run the method once on the full dataset
  out <- run_one_sim_pairwise(
    N = 2000,
    G = 300,
    K = 6,
    frac_diff = 0.4,
    beta_strength = 2,
    seed = r
  )
  
  # compute power / FDR from that run
  m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$pair_true)
  power_vec[r] <- m$power
  fdr_vec[r]   <- m$emp_fdr
  
  # ---- now: stability via bootstrap resampling of THIS dataset
  stab <- stability_for_dataset_pairwise(sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05)
  
  # store:
  stab_jaccvec[r] <- stab$mean_jacc_stab
  # stab$topic_freq is per-topic; you can average it or keep all of it
  stab_avgfreq[r] <- mean(stab$pair_freq)
}

cat("=== Pairwise log contrast + limma : SIGNAL scenario ===\n")
cat("Mean power across sims          =", round(mean(power_vec, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean empirical FDR across sims  =", round(mean(fdr_vec), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean Jaccard stability          =", round(mean(stab_jaccvec, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
cat("Mean topic pair discovery frequency  =", round(mean(stab_avgfreq, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")

```
## stability
```{r}
# --- Single simulation: pairwise log-contrast + limma + stability ---

set.seed(123)

# 1️⃣ Simulate ONE dataset
sim <- simulate_topics_dirichlet(
  N = 2000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,       # fraction of topics with true difference
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
)

# Print which topics are truly differential
cat("True differential topics (TRUE = different):\n")
print(sim$diff_topics)

# 2️⃣ Run pairwise log-contrast method on this dataset
out <- run_one_sim_pairwise(
  N = 2000,
  G = 300,
  K = 6,
  frac_diff = 0.4,
  beta_strength = 2,
  seed = 123
)

# Compute power and empirical FDR
m <- compute_metrics(out$disc, out$pair_true)
cat("\n=== Pairwise log-contrast + limma : single run ===\n")
cat("Power =", round(m$power, 3), "\n")
cat("Empirical FDR =", round(m$emp_fdr, 3), "\n")

# 3️⃣ Bootstrap stability (B = 50)
stab <- stability_for_dataset_pairwise(sim, B = 50, fdr_thresh = 0.05)

# 4️⃣ Summaries
cat("\n=== Bootstrap stability results (B = 50) ===\n")
0 1
cat("Mean Jaccard stability =", round(stab$mean_jacc, 3), "\n\n")

# pair_freq: how often each topic pair was discovered (0–1)
cat("Pairwise discovery frequencies:\n")
pair_summary <- data.frame(
  Pair = paste0("Pair", seq_along(stab$pair_freq)),
  TrueDiff = out$pair_true,
  DiscoveryFreq = round(stab$pair_freq, 3)
)
print(pair_summary, row.names = FALSE)

```
